QUOTE: `_data_stale` returns false when the process does not match its source, so an auto-refresh never runs the build that could corrupt the index. `stale_code_refusal()` is the guard every write path calls first.
VERDICT: MISS
WHY: The answer explains that writes from stale code are refused, but it never states that reads stay current because query tools open the database per call. The read/write asymmetry on the code axis is therefore absent.
